summary.interpretation: observed stage partition; input-ACK to enqueue includes feedback/lease eligibility; phase/lease overlaps are not causal exclusive shares or counterfactual savings

summary.performance_effect_criterion: same frozen input/source/model/load/repeat; unchanged protected invariants and accepted obligations; actual all-offered joint-deadline goodput/coverage or other-session stall improves; report quality/energy and any tradeoff; single pair only mechanism/value evidence, no population claim
summary.source_independence: repeats, deadline windows, models and arms reuse source clusters; do not count them as new speakers
summary.canonical_history_rule: report full F/Z/P/text history equality by matched session; do not require equality or hide differences

summary.evidence_tier: offline recount of actual recorded views and complete result ancestry; not a new serving experiment
limits: No causal effect is inferred from pooled counts or differing Canonical histories.
Unresolved ancestry and unmatched Consumer observations remain explicit.
Compatibility is exact selected-state agreement, not task correctness or a deterministic guarantee.
Owner-install and Consumer-apply observations have separate denominators and counts.
In-flight/complete-unpublished job counts are incidence counts at installs, not certified computational retention opportunities.
Existing independent safety, provenance, deadline, quality and cost gates remain separate.

summary.normalization: NFKC; casefold; curly apostrophe to ASCII; Unicode letter/digit tokens with internal apostrophes; discard other punctuation; single spaces
summary.interpretation: Future selected full Canonical agreement at exactly the observed visible F; not groundtruth, semantic correctness, final WER, or deployed verification.
summary.audio_partition: Each offered frontier audio weight is assigned exactly once to its first actual covering Consumer view. Comparison is at that complete visible snapshot F, which may exceed the offered frontier. Unmatched same-F boundaries remain in the offered denominator.
summary.view_exposure: All actual ahead views and session-wall exposure are descriptive; they are not additional independent audio samples.
summary.lead_definition: Selected lead is actual Canonical installed_perf minus actual Consumer observed_perf; negative/zero means already selected. Consumer-certification lead is reported separately.
